prologue.description: A pinprick in the dark becomes the Moon as the camera races toward it. A radio signal crackles.
On an old television set, Apollo 11 footage shows Neil Armstrong in the lunar module's shadow. The camera eases toward the screen.
The picture shrinks into a flickering television. On an alien ship, Zorvax springs forward to greet the astronaut.

lines.text: Zorvax: They left Earth! They’re coming!

prologue.description: Nyxen holds up one finger. Zorvax throws his arms wide anyway.
The cadet fires the party cannon. The lights go rose and teal, foil strips fly, and the crew dances beneath a welcome banner.
One last streamer lodges in the cannon. The cannon coughs twice.
A time-lapse: the years roll from 1969 to 2026. The lights fade, the banner sags and the confetti stays where it fell. The crew is still waiting.

lines.text: Cadet B: Should I take the banner down?
Zorvax: Not until they get here.

prologue.description: The television lights up with news of the Artemis missions, washing the crew in blue. Zorvax stares in disbelief.

lines.text: Nyxen: And then straight back home, sir.

prologue.description: Through the window, Earth rolls out of the night and into the sunlight. Zorvax takes a long look at the planet humans keep coming home to.

lines.text: Zorvax: Every time. Straight back to that planet.
Zorvax: What does it have that ours doesn’t?

prologue.description: In the gloom, Zorvax slams a red switch. Every light on the bridge kicks on.
Operation: The Great Homecoming. Better together. Love thy human.

briefing.description: Nyxen switches on the projector. A miniature Earth rises over the research bench in cyan light. The scanner sweeps across it.

lines.text: Nyxen: A working copy of Earth. Perfectly safe.
Nyxen: Your planet now. Try the dials.

ending.description: Zorvax presents your report and reaches for the party cannon. Nyxen points to the word SIMULATION.

lines.text: Nyxen: Sir, we ran a simulation.

ending.description: The last party balloon deflates with a squeak. The crew is still waiting.
